name: io.github.udah1/cursor-chat-bridge
description: Control the Cursor AI agent from a chat app (Telegram, Discord, GitHub) — with image attachments and voice notes transcribed to text. Pluggable transport adapters + a local daemon + MCP tools + hooks.

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_PLATFORM
environmentVariables.description: Which chat adapter to use: telegram | discord | github. Optional — defaults to activeAdapter in ~/.cursor/chat-bridge/config.json.
